method: The course handicap is Handicap Index × Slope Rating ÷ 113 + (Course Rating − Par), rounded to the nearest whole number with halves rounded away from zero; a negative result is a plus handicap. The playing handicap is the rounded course handicap multiplied by the allowance percentage and rounded the same way; 95% is the WHS default for individual stroke play. When a gross score is entered, the score differential is (113 ÷ Slope Rating) × (gross score − Course Rating), rounded to one decimal, and the net score is the gross score minus the playing handicap. The target score is par plus the playing handicap. Nine-hole rounds, mixed tees, exceptional score reductions, allowances other than the one entered and the Handicap Index averaging table are not modelled.
